description: This Java class 'TestConnectionConflictStrategy' handles conflict resolution for 'TestConnection' commands in a connectivity messaging persistence layer. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides the 'doApply' method to generate a 'TestConnectionResponse' indicating that the connection already exists.

classes.name: TestConnectionConflictStrategy
classes.description: Handles conflict scenarios for the TestConnection command when a conflict has been detected during connectivity testing.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the base method to produce a 'TestConnectionResponse' indicating that the connection has already been created, given the current context, entity, command, and metadata.
